why: In the Norway items pressing outward can mean either claiming a neighbour's ground for the room's own work (T3-061) or calling to destroy the neighbour's work (T3-006), and the same concepts often sit on the boundary.

why.T3-061: Most concepts press the room's own work into space a neighbour holds — claiming the logo's area, telling Texas to move, reserving room for Norwegian art — rather than merely destroying (T3-006, two concepts) or converting a neighbour's art (T3-068, two concepts).

why.T3-002: The concepts are calls to the room's own members or to fellow communities to come and place, asking for hands and help on the logo, which is T3-002's gate; recruiting from other subs (T3-062) has only two concepts and the coordinates (T3-070) ride inside the calls, not lead them.

why.T3-065: The room rallies to build, size and fix the Norwegian flag itself — proportions corrected, coordinates given, all hands called to its upper-left corner — so the doing is building the homeland's flag under T3-065, not a general call to place (T3-002) which its decide_when_both assigns to any other picture.

why.T3-113: Each concept places a recognisable Norwegian thing — an ostehøvel, a Norwegian carrot, a chess pawn — inside or on the flag, which is T3-113's drawing of national emblems rather than building the flag itself (T3-065).

why.T3-090: Visitors, delegates and requests are told the canvas business lives on r/norge, the sub coordinating the flag, and are sent there — canvas talk redirected to the place sub; the Discord-channel concepts are fewer and secondary.

why.T3-061: Same packet item as position 1: the concepts press the room's own work into space neighbours hold (claiming the logo's area, moving Texas, reserving room for art), which is T3-061 rather than destroying (T3-006) or converting (T3-068), each of which has only two concepts.

why.T3-044: The room counts and qualifies the subscriber growth the canvas brought — Place as a traffic boost, the gap to r/furry, the hoped-for Hiveswap synergy — which is the newcomer/subscriber counting of T3-044 rather than welcoming visitors or ordinary talk.

why.T3-058: The retrospective turns on blame kept alive after the close — the r/homelab dispute kept visible, name-and-shame, rejecting the minimal-damage claim, recounting the raid — which is T3-058's blaming of attackers after the close, while mourning (T3-029) and reporting (T3-073) have only two concepts each.

why.T3-150: Most concepts propose, join or affirm alliances between rooms — with r/india, r/bindingofisaac, the Void, Starbound/Undertale, r/metroid and r/yee — which is T3-150's forming of alliances for defence or a fight.
why.T3-011: A second distinct practice sends the room's own pixels to an ally's work with nothing asked: helping India beat back the void, keeping India from falling, warning that India is under attack, helping ss13's logo.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-150's gate covers alliances proposed and joined, but not the room sending its pixels to allies' works with nothing asked — India's flag repaired, ss13 helped against the void, warnings that an ally is under attack — which the single placement would fail to carry.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concepts C0255293, C0512858, C0788109, C0376444 send the room's pixels to another room's work with nothing asked, satisfying T3-011's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-011: dropping it would lose the reciprocal-help material — the room helping its allies' works — leaving only the alliance-making.

why.T3-054: Every concept carries the Sburb logo/house onto a later canvas — PlaceTwo, Place2, a larger successor — which is T3-054's taking work to new canvases, not remaking it in another medium (T3-057).

why.T3-052: The concepts remark among members on the pictures beside and around the room's own mark — the 413612 next to Isaac and Flowey, r/throwers arriving, neighbours drawing closer, who put canwc — which is T3-052, not the decoding of a detail's meaning (T3-018).

why.T3-150: The largest share forms and affirms pacts between rooms — the Crusader Kings pact made, thanked and repeated, the call for Texas to stand with Norway, the reassurance to allies.
why.T3-010: A distinct second practice settles lines and space with neighbours where no fight began: asking Norway to preserve artworks while expanding, asking for independence and coexistence, reporting which neighbouring flags were contacted.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-150's gate covers pacts and alliances, but not the settling of lines and space between neighbours — asking Norway to preserve artworks while expanding, asking for independence and coexistence, reporting which neighbours were contacted about their borders — which the single placement would fail to carry.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concepts C0355210, C0354196, C1321858 settle lines, overlaps and space between neighbouring works with no fight to end, satisfying T3-010's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-010: dropping it would lose the border/space-settling material, leaving only the pact-making.

why.T3-024: The room keeps off others' work by its own choice — staying within borders, sparing Twitch as a good neighbour, wanting fun not war, rejecting a raid, saying the factions were just fun — which is T3-024's restraint, while calls to stop one's own attackers (T3-076) and fairness arguments (T3-046) have only one or two concepts each.

why.T3-139: The bulk are incoming pleas addressed to Norway to stop or spare a work — spare the Madeon/day9/ffxiv/Slovakia works, stop attacking factorio and crusaderkings, stop eating Jasper and the zergling — which is T3-139's pleading with attackers.
why.T3-035: A distinct slice asks the room that holds space for room to build: to migrate into the flag's bottom right, a small bit and a highway to Czechia, an ffxiv plot, permission to stake a claim.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-139's gate covers pleas to an attacking room to stop or spare the work, but not the incoming requests for a small place to build — asking to migrate into the flag, a small bit and a highway, an ffxiv plot, permission to stake a claim — which the single placement would fail to carry.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concepts C0949434, C0909554, C0913642, C0202987 ask the room that holds space for room to build, satisfying T3-035's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-035: dropping it would lose the space-request material, leaving only the pleas to stop attacking.

why.T3-015: Half the concepts gather place/copycat talk into a single stickied master thread and route posts there — T3-015's megathread routing — while making a new sub (T3-090) has only two concepts and the bare complaint about crowding (T3-075) one.
